loeb.name: Dan Loeb
loeb.detail: Founder of Third Point. This record follows the Offshore Fund, including legacy private investments, after reported fund fees and expenses. Its mix of equities, credit and hedges differs from SPY. Reported fee conventions changed in 2020; it is a fund record, not Loeb’s personal return.
loeb.method: Compounded from published calendar-year net returns. Values are approximate because the annual figures are rounded.

pabrai.name: Mohnish Pabrai
pabrai.detail: The comparison uses Pabrai Investment Fund 3 consistently, not a blend of the best-performing Pabrai funds. Annual net returns in Appendix B are checked against year-end NAVs in Appendix D of the 2025 annual report. The ten-year result is calculated from those observations because the report’s headline summary table is inconsistent with its appendices.
pabrai.sourceLabel: Pabrai · annual reports and NAV history
pabrai.method: Compounded from published calendar-year net returns. Values are approximate because the annual figures are rounded. The calculated 10Y CAGR is about 11.4%, consistent with the NAV appendix ($41.33 to $122.07); the report’s headline table instead states 8.9%. This conflict is disclosed rather than silently using that headline.

smith.name: Terry Smith
smith.detail: Fundsmith Equity T Accumulation total returns, after fund expenses, translated from GBP into USD at each year-end. Currency movements are included. This global-equity strategy has a different investment universe from the S&P 500; SPY measures the alternative of buying the U.S. index.
smith.method: Published T Acc GBP returns translated to USD using year-end exchange rates. FX valuation times can differ from the fund’s valuation time; values are approximate.

dataSources.label: GBP annual return history · Morningstar report hosted by Fundsmith

gabelli.name: Mario Gabelli
gabelli.detail: Gabelli Asset Fund Class AAA (GABAX) total returns, with distributions reinvested and fund expenses included. Class AAA has no sales load. Gabelli leads a management team; these are the fund’s results rather than his personal portfolio or GAMCO’s share price.
gabelli.method: Compounded from published calendar-year net returns. Values are approximate because the annual figures are rounded.

danoff.name: Will Danoff
danoff.detail: Fidelity Contrafund (FCNTX) NAV total returns, after fund expenses, with distributions reinvested. Danoff managed the fund throughout this comparison period. Asher Anolic and Jason Weiner joined him as co-managers in April 2025, so the final year includes a shared management team.
danoff.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

asness.name: Cliff Asness
asness.detail: AQR Long-Short Equity Fund Class I (QLEIX), co-managed by Asness and the AQR team. Published NAV returns include fund expenses and reinvested distributions. The strategy targets moderate equity exposure and uses short positions; beating SPY is an opportunity-cost comparison, not its stated mandate.
asness.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

berkowitz.name: Bruce Berkowitz
berkowitz.detail: The Fairholme Fund (FAIRX), led by Bruce Berkowitz, measured at NAV after expenses with distributions reinvested. Its concentrated holdings can produce large differences from the broad S&P 500. The record covers calendar years 2016–2025, rather than the fund’s November fiscal-year endpoints.
berkowitz.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

watsa.name: Prem Watsa
watsa.detail: Fairfax Financial shareholder total returns, including dividends, translated into USD. This measures an investment in the listed company, including its insurance operations and valuation changes. It is not the return on Fairfax’s investment portfolio or Watsa’s personal wealth.
watsa.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end share prices. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision. Converted to USD using year-end exchange rates; fund and FX valuation times can differ.

gayner.name: Tom Gayner
gayner.detail: Markel Group (MKL) shareholder return in USD. Gayner was co-CEO during 2016–2022 and CEO from 2023. The share return includes insurance and operating businesses, investment results, and market valuation; it is not the return of the equity portfolio he manages.
gayner.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end share prices. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

hussman.name: John Hussman
hussman.detail: Hussman Strategic Market Cycle Fund (HSGFX), formerly Strategic Growth, at NAV with distributions reinvested. Its mandate emphasizes capital protection and varying market exposure. Hedging can cause it to lag a rising equity market; the comparison with SPY measures opportunity cost, not whether it met its risk-management objective.
hussman.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

nygren.name: Bill Nygren
nygren.detail: Oakmark Fund Investor Class (OAKMX), after fund expenses with distributions reinvested. Bill Nygren was a manager throughout 2016–2025; the fund is co-managed. Its value-oriented portfolio can differ substantially from the S&P 500’s sector and style exposures.
nygren.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

davis.name: Chris Davis
davis.detail: Davis New York Venture Fund Class A (NYVTX), co-managed by Chris Davis and Danton Goei. NAV total returns include operating expenses and reinvested distributions but exclude the maximum 4.75% initial sales charge. An investor paying that charge would receive lower returns.
davis.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

rogers.name: John Rogers Jr.
rogers.detail: Ariel Fund Investor Class (ARGFX) NAV total returns with distributions reinvested and expenses included. Rogers leads the management team. The fund focuses on small and mid-sized value stocks; SPY is an alternative investment comparison rather than its primary strategy benchmark.
rogers.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.

herro.name: David Herro
herro.detail: Oakmark International Fund Investor Class (OAKIX), co-managed by David Herro, with expenses included and distributions reinvested. USD returns include the currency exposure of its international holdings. Its investment universe differs from U.S.-focused SPY.
herro.method: Estimated from dividend- and split-adjusted year-end NAVs. Small differences from published fund total returns can arise from distribution-reinvestment conventions and source precision.
